The '''spotted jugadoo''', also known as '''jugaloo''',<ref>''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' {{ID|"Juggadoo"}}</ref> was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Color/Legends|multicolored]] elephantine creatures native to the planet [[Dandelo]], from the  [[Dandelo system/Legends|Dandelo system]].

== History ==
In the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a rare spotted jugadoo was hunted down by [[Starhunter's Intergalactic Menagerie]].<ref name=":0">{{DroidsCite|Coby and the Starhunters}}</ref> In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}} states that [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] is set 15 years before [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of '' A New Hope'' in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], meaning that ''Star Wars: Droids'' takes place in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].</ref> the beast was freed by [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and [[Jann Tosh]]. The creature mistook C-3PO for a potential mate when the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] tried to mimic its vocalizations in a ruse to protect his friends. Thinking the droid a mate, the beast lovingly cuddled him in its trunk. Threepio was less than amused, though his comrades found the incident quite humorous.<ref name=":0" />
